summary: Tests-only red-phase run for issue #5 (generated OpenAPI Swift client). Wrote the full stubbed-response test suite for the six API surfaces plus the contract-delta record. Red by design: the generated ColorMatchingOpenAPI module does not exist yet, so the new suites cannot compile until the implementation run lands; additionally, no Swift toolchain exists in this container, so swift test cannot execute here (CI on macos-latest is the executor of record). Exit criterion 'swift test --disable-sandbox green with generated types' is therefore not met at this head and is expected to be satisfied by the follow-up implementation run after paid-tests-approved.
